topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Well, ain’t that just the work of Providence! Hardly had the last furrow been turned in the spring, and now I hear Ole Tom’s headed off to that bustling city across the mountains. Mind you, I always thought the world beyond our valley was but a whisper of a tale, too far to think about. Yet, there he stands, packing his things, ready to chase some dream only the young and the restless dream of. I reckon the roads will be long, and the nights colder. I told him, “Tom, the good earth is here, and it feeds us, and there’s a comfort in that.” But he’s got other thoughts. Hope he remembers to take a bit of this soil with him, for it’s the roots that keep us true.
